description: Request a top count from 1 to 200, default 50, to rank valid DefiLlama protocol records by reported TVL in USD. Includes source-universe counts, discarded rows and capture time. The provider universe can include centralized exchanges. Observation time is unavailable; TVL is not an attestation of reserves or solvency. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]
name: defi_llama_tvl_ranking
